description: Student dropout early-warning service: live operations, prediction analytics, drift, offline model quality and fairness.

options.content: ### 🎓 Student Dropout Early Warning — MLOps Command Center Live **service health**, **prediction behaviour**, **data drift** and **operational alerts** from the FastAPI `/metrics` endpoint, side by side with the **offline model quality, fairness and explainability** results the batch pipeline publishes. Risk tiers use status colours (LOW · MODERATE · HIGH · CRITICAL). Use the **model / split / attribute** selectors for the offline rows.

panels.title: API status
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health of the inference API.

panels.title: Risk model
panels.description: 1 when the XGBoost pipeline and intervention rules are loaded.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the API process started.

panels.title: Scored / s
panels.description: Single + batch predictions per second.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed prediction requests / all prediction requests. Alert at 10 %.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile prediction latency. Alert at 1 s.

panels.title: Review rate
panels.description: Share of the live window routed to a human advisor (HIGH + CRITICAL).

panels.title: Drifting features
panels.description: Features at moderate or substantial drift vs the training reference profile.

panels.title: Students scored (total)
panels.description: Cumulative since process start.

panels.title: Mean predicted risk
panels.description: Mean dropout probability in the live window, banded by tier cut-offs.

panels.title: Critical tier share
panels.description: Share of the live window in the CRITICAL tier (validation baseline ≈ 3.5 %).

panels.title: SHAP explanation share
panels.description: Share of scored students that received a SHAP explanation.

panels.title: Fairness applied
panels.description: Share of predictions where the ThresholdOptimizer decision was applied (gender supplied).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules currently firing (see Alerts row).

panels.title: Prediction Request Rate
panels.description: Prediction requests per second by endpoint.

panels.title: Students scored by source
panels.description: Students per second, single requests vs batch jobs.

panels.title: HTTP responses by status
panels.description: All API traffic (excluding Prometheus scrapes) grouped by status class.

panels.title: Prediction Error Rate
panels.description: Share of prediction requests failing server-side, and share rejected by input validation. Dashed line: 10 % alert threshold.

panels.title: Prediction Latency
panels.description: Single-prediction latency quantiles. Dashed line: 1 s p95 alert.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Every prediction request bucketed by latency over time.

panels.title: Apdex (T = 100 ms)
panels.description: Satisfied ≤ 100 ms, tolerating ≤ 500 ms. Bands: green ≥ 0.94, amber ≥ 0.85.

panels.title: p95 latency by endpoint
panels.description: Server-side request duration per route (includes batch and insights endpoints).

panels.title: Batch scoring
panels.description: Distribution of batch sizes (students per /predict/batch call).

panels.title: Risk tier mix (live window)
panels.description: Share of each risk tier among the most recent students scored.

panels.title: Students scored by risk tier
panels.description: Students per interval, stacked by tier.

panels.title: Risk score distribution over time
panels.description: Predicted dropout probability histogram (5 % buckets) per interval.

panels.title: Risk score quantiles
panels.description: Dashed lines mark the MODERATE / HIGH / CRITICAL cut-offs (0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5).

panels.title: Recommended interventions
panels.description: Interventions recommended in the selected time range.

panels.title: Human review inflow
panels.description: Students per minute flagged for human review (HIGH and CRITICAL tiers).

panels.title: Fairness post-processing outcomes
panels.description: Whether the ThresholdOptimizer decision could be applied.

panels.title: Fairness-adjusted flag rate
panels.description: Share flagged by the fairness-adjusted decision vs share routed to review by risk tier.

panels.title: Null inputs by feature
panels.description: Share of scored students with a null value per nullable feature.

panels.title: Data drift — live window vs training reference
Drift status by feature
panels.description: PSI (numeric) / TVD (categorical) status per feature over time. Starts once the window holds enough samples.

panels.title: PSI by feature (numeric)
panels.description: Population Stability Index. < 0.10 stable, 0.10–0.25 moderate, ≥ 0.25 substantial.

panels.title: TVD by feature (categorical)
panels.description: Total variation distance. < 0.05 stable, 0.05–0.15 moderate, ≥ 0.15 substantial.

panels.title: Window size
panels.description: Predictions in the rolling window (max 2,000). Numeric drift needs 500, categorical 1,500.

panels.title: Reference profile
panels.description: Source of the drift reference (development_train = exact deciles; eda_numeric_summary = approximation).

panels.title: Drifted features over time
panels.description: Number of features in moderate / substantial drift.

panels.title: Feature mean relative to reference (1.0 = unchanged)
panels.description: Window mean ÷ training mean per numeric feature, indexed so every feature shares one axis.

targets.expr: max by (feature) (student_dropout_feature_window_mean{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / on (feature) max by (feature) (student_dropout_feature_reference_mean{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: PSI trend by feature
panels.description: How quickly each feature drifts as the window rolls. Dashed lines: 0.10 / 0.25.

panels.title: ROC AUC
panels.description: ROC AUC of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: PR AUC
panels.description: PR AUC of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: Recall
panels.description: Recall of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: Precision
panels.description: Precision of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: F1
panels.description: F1 of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: Specificity
panels.description: Specificity of the selected model on the selected split (reports/models/baseline_comparison.csv).

panels.title: Baseline comparison
panels.description: lr = Logistic Regression, rf = Random Forest, xgb = XGBoost (deployed).

panels.title: Observed withdrawal rate by risk tier
panels.description: Validation split: share of students in each tier who actually withdrew. Rising bars = tiers separate risk.

panels.title: Tier population share
panels.description: Validation split: share of students per tier.

panels.title: Threshold trade-off (validation)
panels.description: Precision / recall / F1 if a single probability threshold raised the alert.

panels.title: Global SHAP importance (top 15)
panels.description: Mean |SHAP| per transformed feature on the validation split.

panels.title: Calibration by method ($model)
panels.description: Lower Brier / ECE / log loss is better. Sigmoid calibration inverted the ranking (ROC AUC < 0.5).

panels.title: Automated pipeline — latest validation run
panels.description: reports/pipeline/pipeline_run_*.json (newest).

panels.title: Demographic parity difference
panels.description: Max gap in selection rate between groups. Green < 0.05, amber < 0.10.

panels.title: Equalized odds difference
panels.description: Max gap in TPR or FPR between groups. Green < 0.05, amber < 0.10.

panels.title: Deployed mitigation: XGBoost + ThresholdOptimizer (gender, test)
panels.description: Lower EOD / DPD is fairer; higher recall catches more withdrawals.

panels.title: Group outcomes — $attribute
panels.description: Selection rate = share flagged; TPR = withdrawals caught; FPR = false alarms. Groups under 50 students are noisy.

panels.title: True positive rate by group — $attribute
panels.description: Equal opportunity view: a fair model catches withdrawals at similar rates in every group.

panels.title: Serving components
panels.description: Risk model, intervention engine, fairness post-processor and SHAP explainer health.

panels.title: Served model
panels.description: Artifact metadata published by the API at start-up.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules in firing state (monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml).
